Depends on how long it takes you to collect 100 Vampire Lord Tokens

The inquisitor {npc:Storkus}, in Kazordoon, rewards those who bring him proof of the death of {wiki:Vampire Lords|Vampire Lords}: the {item:Vampire Lord Token|Vampire Lord Tokens}. By handing in 100 tokens in six batches you climb six vampire hunter ranks and earn a total of 186,000 experience points, a {item:Vampire Doll}, the achievement **Razing!** and access to the {item:Blood Skull} in the Vengoth Castle basement.
If you run into one of the Vampire Lords and kill it, it drops proof of its death. Storkus may be interested.
Storkus, west of the Dwarf Bridge (near Kazordoon)

When you reach the **Razing** rank (batch of 50 {item:Vampire Lord Token|Vampire Lord Tokens}) with {npc:Storkus}.
You do not have to kill the Vampire Lords yourself: you can buy the tokens from other players.
The Vampire Lords appear in several places: {wiki:Hellgate|Hellgate}, {wiki:Nargor|Nargor}, {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, {wiki:Edron|Edron} and {wiki:Kazordoon|Kazordoon}.
Each rank requires you to hand in **all** the tokens of that batch **at once**. Handing in 3 at a time for the Lucky rank does not work.
Kill {wiki:Vampire Lords|Vampire Lords} (or buy the tokens from other players). Each one drops a {item:Vampire Lord Token} as proof of death. You need 100 in total.

{npc:Storkus} is in Kazordoon. On each visit say {key:hi}, {key:Vampire Lord Token} and {key:yes}. You must have exactly the number of tokens for the next rank in your inventory: he accepts the whole batch at once.

{npc:Storkus} is not inside the city: he lives on the surface, on the way to **Kazordoon**, **west** of the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}. The Dwarf Bridge is in the centre of the continent, on the road between the southern and northern cities (northeast of Thais, southeast of Carlin, southwest of Ab'Dendriel and northwest of Venore). To leave, just go back along the same road to your city.
Storkus, west of the Dwarf Bridge
On the Dwarf Bridge there are {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} and {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}, dangerous for very low-level characters.
These are the batches, in order:
100,000 experience, {item:Vampire Doll}, achievement **Razing!** and access to the {item:Blood Skull}
With **1** token, say {key:hi}, {key:Vampire Lord Token} and {key:yes}. You receive 1,000 experience.
With **4** tokens, repeat {key:hi}, {key:Vampire Lord Token} and {key:yes}. You receive 5,000 experience.
With **5** tokens, repeat {key:hi}, {key:Vampire Lord Token} and {key:yes}. You receive 10,000 experience.
With **10** tokens, repeat {key:hi}, {key:Vampire Lord Token} and {key:yes}. You receive 20,000 experience.
With **30** tokens, repeat {key:hi}, {key:Vampire Lord Token} and {key:yes}. You receive 50,000 experience.

With **50** tokens, repeat {key:hi}, {key:Vampire Lord Token} and {key:yes}. You receive 100,000 experience, a {item:Vampire Doll} and the achievement **Razing!**. You can also now get the {item:Blood Skull} in the basement of {wiki:Vengoth Castle|Vengoth Castle}.
